name: Thyroid, desiccated

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: Dried porcine thyroid gland standardised by iodine content, containing both thyroxine and triiodothyronine. Marketed in the United States under enforcement discretion as an unapproved drug rather than under an approved NDA. Marketed as an unapproved drug under enforcement discretion; there is no FDA-approved application for desiccated thyroid.

systems.note: Supplies both thyroxine and triiodothyronine; the intended replacement.
The T3 fraction produces peaked levels with the same arrhythmic concern as liothyronine.

monitors.why: The T3 fraction produces a peaked level; timing relative to the dose matters.
Runs lower on T3-containing regimens than on thyroxine alone.
